text: Alcohols react at three places. The O H bond, where the hydrogen is weakly acidic. The carbon oxygen bond, where the O H is replaced or lost. And the alpha carbon hydrogen bonds, which are attacked in oxidation. Keep this picture in mind, and every reaction falls into place. We will collect them all into one map as we go.
